<source id="FAQ-020" type="document">
How long does standard delivery take? (United States)

Standard delivery in the United States takes 3–5 business days after dispatch; express takes 1–2 business days.
</source>
<source id="FAQ-029" type="document">
How long does standard delivery take? (European Union)

Standard delivery in the European Union takes 4–7 business days after dispatch; express takes 2–3 business days.
</source>
<source id="FAQ-026" type="document">
How long does standard delivery take? (United Kingdom)

Standard delivery in the United Kingdom takes 2–4 business days after dispatch; express takes next business day.
</source>
<source id="FAQ-023" type="document">
How long does standard delivery take? (Canada)

Standard delivery in Canada takes 5–8 business days after dispatch; express takes 2–3 business days.
</source>
<source id="POL-SHIPPING-EU" type="document">
Shipping policy (European Union) > Delivery times

- **Standard:** 4–7 business days after dispatch.
- **Express:** 2–3 business days after dispatch.

Orders placed before noon local time on a business day are usually dispatched the same day.
The delivery date for your order is shown at checkout and in your order tracking.
</source>

Shopper question: How long does standard delivery take?
